gloss: to wait ready; to lie in wait; to await eagerly

definitions.gloss: to wait ready for; to lie in wait for; to be waiting eagerly
definitions.explanation: To wait for someone or something while fully prepared for its arrival, whether to welcome it, deal with it, or ambush it. Often in the ている form, describing a state of readiness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ち{構|かま}えて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ち{構|かま}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children are eagerly awaiting the summer holidays.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧で、⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ち{構|かま}えて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: At the airport exit, a crowd of fans was waiting for the players to arrive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}する→入社する：25409_nyuushasuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{山|やま}のよう→山のよう：28662_yamanoyou⟧な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ち{構|かま}えて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I joined the company, a mountain of work was waiting for me.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait) and ⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ (to take a stance, to get ready). It adds readiness to plain waiting: the person is poised to act the moment the awaited thing arrives. The object takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧; the subject can also be a thing that lies ahead, such as hardships or work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{獲物|えもの}→獲物：08638_emono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ち{構|かま}える: to lie in wait for prey
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{待|ま}ち{構|かま}える: to wait impatiently, wondering if it is now
- ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ち{構|かま}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: difficulties lie ahead

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {待|ま}ち{受|う}ける: to await, to lie ahead — close, but without the sense of being braced or poised
- {待|ま}ちわびる: to wait impatiently — stresses the long, tiring wait rather than readiness
